findings.summary: The new Delete affordance says the schedule is left stale until the goal is next saved, but it invokes operation.contact.log, which recomputes affected goals; deleting an event that set last contact would also leave the schedule wrong, against C.webapp.schedule.correct.
findings.evidence: affordance effects: "The schedule is left as it is until the goal is next saved" vs operation.contact.log effects: "Persist event, Recompute affected goals without sending anything"

findings.summary: Deletion is added to the log operation without a matching precondition or failure, so the operation's only stated preconditions (owned contact, nonfuture event time) don't cover an 'Owned event' deletion and there is no failure case for a missing or unowned event.
findings.evidence: preconditions: [Owned contact, Nonfuture event time] ... effects: [..., Deleting an event removes it from history]; affordance preconditions: [Owned contact, Owned event]
